items.raw_excerpt: If you’re of a certain age you might remember that a Sunday was shut down day and it was so quiet you could hear a pin drop!
items.summary_en: In the past, almost every shop in Portugal was closed on Sundays. The streets felt so quiet that you could hear a pin drop. Now people share their thoughts on a slow Sunday afternoon.
items.summary_ko: 한때 포르투갈에서는 일요일이면 가게 대부분이 문을 닫았습니다. 거리가 너무 조용해서 바늘 하나 떨어지는 소리도 들렸습니다. 지금은 느긋한 일요일 오후에 대한 이야기를 나눕니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Students from a Japanese university held a Taiwanese tea tasting and seminar at the 2026 Tourism Expo Japan on Saturday, showcasing teas paired with Japanese confections.
items.summary_en: Students from a Japanese university held a tea tasting for Taiwanese tea at the Tourism Expo Japan in Tokyo. They showed Taiwanese teas and explained how they go well with Japanese sweets. The event is part of efforts to promote Taiwan tea overseas.
items.summary_ko: 일본 대학 학생들이 도쿄 열린 관광 전시회에서 대만차 시음회를 열었다. 이들은 대만차를 일본식 달과자로 어떻게 어울리는지 함께 소개했다. 대만차를 해외에 알리려는 행사였다.
items.title_en: Japanese students promote Taiwan tea at Tokyo expo

items.raw_excerpt: The picturesque Littondale village of Arncliffe is a popular spot for a day out in the Yorkshire Dales and is steeped in history
items.summary_en: Arncliffe is a small village in the Yorkshire Dales. It is known for stone cottages, a clear river and old history. Visitors come here for a quiet day trip.
items.summary_ko: 아른클리프는 요크셔 데일스에 있는 작은 마을입니다. 돌로 지은 오두막과 맑은 강, 오래된 역사가 유명합니다.Visitors가 조용한 하루 여행을 위해 이곳을 찾습니다.
items.title_en: A village in North Yorkshire where time seems to stand still

items.raw_excerpt: Susan's mother, Elizabeth, was five months pregnant when she contracted polio in the 1950s.
items.summary_en: Susan's mother caught polio in the 1950s. She was five months pregnant and could not breathe on her own. Susan was born while her mother was still in an iron lung.

items.title_en: I was born while my mother was in an iron lung

items.raw_excerpt: How much more are consumers paying now for energy, fuel, and on mortgage repayments than before the US began launching strikes on Iran at the end of February?
items.summary_en: In Ireland, families are paying much more for fuel, electricity and their mortgage loans. Costs jumped after the US started strikes on Iran in late February. Households now pay a lot more for the same bills.
items.summary_ko: 아일랜드에서 가구의 휘발유, 전기, 주택담보대출 비용이 크게 올랐다. 미국이 2월 말 이란을 폭격한 뒤부터 비용이 계속 증가했다. 같은 물건과 서비스를 받으면서도 집들은 훨씬 더 많은 돈을 내고 있다.
items.title_en: How much more are Irish families paying for fuel, power and mortgages?

items.raw_excerpt: Primeira descoberta aconteceu em 2013, quando o dono do Sítio Carneirinho decidiu limpar o local de pedras após o nível da água baixar e o dono decidir fazer limpeza.
items.summary_en: When a small lagoon in Caruaru dried up, animal bones and old rock paintings under the water came to light. A local farm owner found the place in 2013 while clearing stones after the water level dropped. Researchers are now studying the find to learn about the people who lived there long ago.
items.summary_ko: 브라질 카루아루의 작은 호수가 말라붙으면서 물 아래 있던 동물 뼈와 오래된 바위 그림이 세상에 드러났습니다. 2013년 한 농부가 수위가 내려앉은 뒤 돌을 치우던 중 이 장소를 처음 발견했습니다. 연구자들은 오래전 이곳에 살았던 사람들을 알아낼 단서를 찾고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Drought Reveals 10,000-Year-Old Fossils and Rock Paintings in Caruaru

items.title_original: Seca em lagoa revela fósseis de animais pré-históricos e pinturas rupestres de 10 mil anos em Caruaru - G1

items.raw_excerpt: When Canada's premiers met in Prince Edward Island back in July, leaders from the Maritime provinces had power on their minds — just not the political kind.
items.summary_en: Premiers from Canada's Maritime provinces met in Prince Edward Island in July. They talked about sharing one power grid across the region. A shared grid might keep electricity more steady for homes.

items.raw_excerpt: A 300-year-old Mexican musical tradition is finding new life around the world — one sweaty, joyous, all-night fandango at a time.
items.summary_en: In Mexico, people dance at all-night parties called fandangos. Musicians play songs like La Bamba for hours without stopping. The 300-year-old tradition is now spreading to new fans around the world.
items.summary_ko: 멕시코에서는 사람들끼리 밤새 춤추는 판당고 파티를 엽니다. 연주자들은 라 밤바 같은 노래를 멈추지 않고 몇 시간 동안 연주합니다. 300년 된 전통이 이제 전 세계의 새로운 팬들에게도 알려지고 있습니다.
items.title_en: A Fandango Night: Dancing to La Bamba for One Hour
items.title_ko: 판당고 한밤, 라 밤바에 춤을 추다
items.title_original: Playing 'La Bamba' for an hour? Must be a Mexican fandango!

items.raw_excerpt: NAGOYA, Japan, Sept 27 : It was never going to be a bed of roses when container-style blocks were used to house athletes, but Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games organisers said using ottomans as extensions could have brought more comfort to taller competitors.Complaints about cramped rooms and small beds surfaced on s
items.summary_en: Athletes at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games said their rooms and beds felt too small. Organisers said they added long cushions as bed extensions so taller competitors could stretch out. They added that the rooms could not be changed any further.
items.summary_ko: 나고야 아시안게임 선수들이 숙소 방과 침대가 너무 좁다고 불만이 있었다. 주최진은 키가 큰 선수들이 몸을 폈을 수 있도록 긴 방석을 침대 연장용으로 더 놓았다고 설명했다. 주최진은 더 이상 숙소를 바꿀 수는 없다고 말했다.
items.title_en: Asian Games organisers answer bed size complaints in Nagoya

items.raw_excerpt: Pedro Leão runs one of Portugal’s most internationally funded marine biotechnology laboratory, the Cyanobacterial Natural Products Team at CIIMAR, in Matosinhos.
items.summary_en: Pedro Leão leads a marine lab in Matosinhos that studies tiny cyanobacteria. His team finds useful substances from these blue-green microbes. Research money from many countries pays for the lab.
